reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, as MLIPs are known to capture many-body interactions better than EAM potentials, but the claimed 30-50% improvement is speculative without evidence and the mechanism of improved phase-space overlap is assumed rather than demonstrated.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and includes a decisive falsification criterion (less than ~20% improvement), but it lacks specific details on the alloy system, MLIP architecture, and how phase-space overlap metrics will be computed, making it somewhat incomplete.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the core limitation of EAM references in TOR-TILD and proposes a practical, modern solution that would be highly valuable to researchers working on high-temperature HEA free-energy calculations.
